exposure: Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) diagnosis during delivery hospitalization
cohort: Women with delivery hospitalizations identified from the Nationwide Inpatient Sample (2004-2014), categorized by the presence or absence of a Traumatic Brain Injury diagnosis on hospital discharge records.
finding: Women with TBI were at an increased risk for placental abruption, stillbirth, and having a baby large for gestational age.
mod_finding: Women with TBI were at an increased risk for cesarean delivery, which was identified as a sequela associated with placental abruption.
